name: Roger Bacon sends Opus Majus to Clement IV
summary: The English Franciscan Roger Bacon, working at the secret request of Clement IV, finishes the Opus Majus, a survey of mathematics, optics, astronomy, alchemy, and moral philosophy advocating experimental method (scientia experimentalis). The manuscript reaches Viterbo shortly before Clement's death.

_quarry.structural_significance: Earliest sustained medieval Latin argument for empirical investigation as a distinct mode of knowledge; revived interest in optics, calendars, and language study at Oxford for a century after.
